[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Sort array by increasing frequency** [LC 1636 · Sort Array by Increasing Frequency](https://leetcode.com/problems/sort-array-by-increasing-frequency/){difficulty="Easy"}

Each element has a two-part score: (its value's frequency, minus its value). Sorting by that tuple is exactly the required order. Stability gives a second way: sort by value descending, then stably by frequency.

[Solved in full in @sec-lang-p3-frequency.]{.card-link}
